business_problem: Driven by its mission "to provide innovative, clean and energy-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow," Delta Electronics , a global leader in power and thermal management, has developed deep sustainability expertise spanning strategic planning to operational execution.
solution_summary: Delta ESG Consulting Office leverages Google AI to boost ESG workflows 600x, streamlining end-to-end operations to amplify global impact. To bring this vision to life, Delta ESG Consulting Office migrated key workloads to and engineered SustainX Navi as a multi-agent platform that provides end-to-end sustainability intelligence, transforming ESG compliance into a scalable enterprise capability. Delta ESG Consulting Office selected Google Cloud for its advanced AI ecosystem. and the provide the reasoning capabilities needed to understand complex ESG data. Its Agent Development Kit (ADK) enables the development of specialized multi-agent services that coordinate complex, multi-step workflows beyond traditional chatbot capabilities.
